chunks.heading: Details of each Segment
chunks.text:
- During the week (28 Aug – 03 Sept 2025), higher rainfall was observed, as compared to Long Period Average (LPA) by 48%. Cumulative seasonal rainfall (01st June to 03rd Sept 2025) is higher than LPA by 8%. Rainfall Forecast: - The monsoon trough now passes through centre of deep depressionover the Southeast Pakistan and adjoining Rajasthan & Kutch, Churu, Agra, Lucknow, Praygraj, Daltonganj Digha and thence eastwards to northeast Bay of Bengal. - Overall, rainfall activity is likely to be normal to above normal over east & northeast India; near normal over central & south Peninsular India and below normal over most parts of northwest India during the week.
| 4


Temerature Week 1 (05 Sept – 11 Sept 2025): - Overall, maximum temperatures are likely to be near normal or below normal over most parts of the country except some parts of east & northeast India, where these are likely to be slightly above normal by about 2°C during the week. Week 2 (12 Sept – 18 September 2025): - Maximum temperature is likely to be above normal over many parts of Karnataka, Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Bihar and Arunachal Pradesh.
